The last step: publish. One window makes all the paperwork of the show. Click Publish in the toolbar.
Tick what you want: the total DB book, the IP address book, LK info and node info for every DB, the stickers, and the A three network flow.
The preview shows the real pages, the same ones that end up in the PDF, with your logos and page numbers on every page.

The stickers are for the Herma sheets: one on every node with its address, VLAN and switch port, and one on every switch. The Stickers button has all the other labels, and a calibration sheet for your printer.
In the last step choose a folder. PatchLab makes a folder with the project name, a folder for every DB, and an A three folder for the network flow.
One click publishes everything. And that is the whole workflow, from the CSV file to the printed show.
